license_basis: Amadeus modifications follow the root AGPL-3.0 license. The upstream CSV relies on the immediate GPT-SoVITS repository-wide MIT grant; retain the CMUdict BSD notice for the stated source chain.

review.policy: Exact bad-reading repairs preserve other lexical alternatives. Unconfirmed lexical transcriptions or accent nuclei are retained. Native compilation and labels do not replace human listening.

rules: Exclude every imported row for a surface selected as one known whole word by an independent base MeCab instance; unknown letter-spelled tokens do not count as known words.

Quarantine all variants of a surface if any reading ends in ズ without CMU S/Z, ド without D/T, or ング without NG. Accept every CMU pronunciation variant. These are the external audit rules; omit its unreachable ッド branch. Do not promote another unverified shifted reading.
Raise plain Latin word costs to one common floor, keeping higher existing costs and punctuation-bearing compound costs; prevent cheap imported fragments from splitting known base words.
extension_filter.limitations: Final-phone screening is conservative quarantine, not proof of an error or a proposed replacement. Legitimate loanword adaptations can be excluded. Interior shifts and vowel-ending errors can escape this rule. The common cost floor is qualified against all base-owned imported words in three native contexts and the retained reviewed-word gate, not all possible Japanese contexts. No runtime word exceptions are added.
extension_filter.cmudict_hash_normalization: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF
